facts.fact: The article calls bjCSIRT the national cybersecurity incident response team and the Asin director general says its recommendations should be implemented; the document gives its date as the 2025-06-26 publication date.

systems.country_label: bjCSIRT (equipe nationale de reponse aux incidents de cybersecurite)

note: The first national vulnerability and incident report (2021-2024) is presented by the Cnin director, not stated as published by the national response body, so no figures or response fact; critical infrastructure operators are named as scope but no designation is stated.
